description_en: Queries the compliance evaluation history of a specified resource. The history is a set of compliance evaluation records that contain the timestamp and details of each evaluation
description_zh: 查询指定资源的合规检测历史。合规检测历史是资源的一组合规评估记录，包括合规检测历史上的点和合规检测历史的内容
kebab_example: aliyun config get-resource-compliance-timeline --resource-type ACS::OSS::Bucket --resource-id new-bucket --biz-region cn-hangzhou --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetResourceComplianceTimeline

parameters.help_en:
The resource type.

For more information about how to obtain the resource type, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169620.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。

关于如何获取类型，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169620.html
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The resource ID.

For more information about how to obtain the resource ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169620.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID。

关于如何获取资源ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169620.html
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp. If you do not set this parameter, the system queries data from the last 30 days. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间戳。默认查询发起调用前30天的时间。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp. If you do not set this parameter, the system queries data generated up to the time of the API call. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间戳。默认查询发起调用时的时间。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on a single page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the return value is truncated, use this token to initiate another request to retrieve the remaining entries
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

ResourceComplianceTimeline.description_en: The compliance evaluation history of the resource

ComplianceList.description_en: The list of compliance evaluation history records
ComplianceList.description_zh: 资源合规检测历史列表

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the resource belongs
AccountId.description_zh: 资源归属的阿里云账号ID

AvailabilityZone.description_en: The zone where the resource resides

CaptureTime.description_en: The timestamp when the compliance evaluation of the resource was recorded. Unit: milliseconds
CaptureTime.description_zh: 记录资源合规评估的时间戳。单位：毫秒

Configuration.description_en: The list of rules associated with the resource and the compliance details of the rules
Configuration.description_zh: 资源关联的规则列表和规则合规详情

ConfigurationDiff.description_en: The details of the resource change that triggered this evaluation
ConfigurationDiff.description_zh: 触发本次评估的资源变更细节

ResourceCreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the resource was created. Unit: milliseconds
ResourceCreateTime.description_zh: 创建资源的时间戳。单位：毫秒

ResourceStatus.description_en:
The resource status. The resource status is defined by each Alibaba Cloud service. This parameter can be empty. For example:

If the resource type is \`ACS::ECS::Instance\`, this parameter can be \`Running\` or \`Stopped\` because ECS instances are stateful.

If the resource type is \`ACS::OSS::Bucket\`, this parameter is empty because OSS buckets are stateless
ResourceStatus.description_zh:
资源状态。资源状态取决于各云服务对其的定义，该参数可能为空。例如：
当资源类型为ACS::ECS::Instance时，由于ECS实例有状态，因此该参数为Running或Stopped。
当资源类型为ACS::OSS::Bucket时，由于OSS Bucket无状态，因此该参数为空

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数

NextToken.description_en: The token that you use to retrieve the next page of results
